chunks: ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn and ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad narrated to me, from al-ʿUbaydī, from Yūnus, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two of them عليهما السلام, who said:

He was asked about a man who joined the Imam in his salat (prayer) after having missed one rakʿah; then when the Imam finished, he went out with the people, and then remembered that he had missed one rakʿah. He said: “He repeats one rakʿah only; that is valid for him so long as he has not turned his face away from the qiblah. But if he has turned his face away completely, he must begin the salat (prayer) anew.”

Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, said: Whoever becomes forgetful in the last two rakʿahs of ẓuhr, ʿaṣr, or ʿishāʾ al-ākhirah and does not know whether he is in the third or the fourth, then he should return to his predominant assumption regarding that. If his assumption is stronger toward one of the two, he should build upon it. If his uncertainty is balanced regarding all of it, he should build upon the greater number and make up what he thinks he has missed. For example, if he is uncertain between the third and the fourth and his assumption is equal regarding both of them, then he should build on his being in the fourth, recite tashahhud, and give salām, then stand and perform one rakʿah in which he recites tashahhud, or perform two rakʿahs while sitting and recite tashahhud in the second of them.

key_terms.سَهَا: became forgetful or made an unintentional mistake in salat (prayer)
key_terms.ظَنِّهِ: one’s predominant assumption or stronger estimation in resolving doubt
key_terms.يَتَشَهَّدُ: recites the tashahhud in the sitting posture of salat (prayer)
key_terms.يُسَلِّمُ: gives the concluding salām that ends the salat (prayer)
key_terms.ٱلصَّلَاةَ: the ritual salat (prayer) being discussed in the ruling
key_terms.ٱلْإِمَامِ: the prayer leader whom the follower is joining in congregational salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he misses a rakʿah with the Imam or doubts whether he is in the third or fourth rakʿah of salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This report addresses legal rulings concerning forgetfulness and missed units in salat (prayer), especially for one who joined the Imam late or became uncertain between the third and fourth rakʿah. It explains when a missed rakʿah may be completed and when the entire salat (prayer) must be restarted, while also outlining how to act upon predominant assumption or, in the case of equal doubt, to build on the greater number and perform precautionary prayer.
